result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The main problem is a stray dark horizontal bar overlaying the bottom navigation, which makes the tab bar look broken. There are also minor clipping/truncation issues on horizontally scrolling content near the right edge.

issues.description: A dark horizontal bar appears across the bottom navigation area, cutting through the search and saved/bookmark icons. This looks like a misplaced system gesture indicator or rendering artifact and makes the navigation visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Move the gesture/home indicator to the very bottom safe area, or ensure the bottom navigation is positioned above it with proper safe-area padding. Check z-index/layering so no overlay crosses the nav icons.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrolling items are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category chip row and the restaurant carousel item/title. This may be intentional carousel behavior, but it looks slightly unfinished in this screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer right-side padding or adjust carousel item widths so partially visible items appear intentional and text does not get awkwardly cut off.
